# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Mar 13, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on CI/CD pipeline enhancements, migration to `justfiles`, and critical bug fixes across various components, alongside significant updates to Rust-based historical proofs and documentation for AI agents.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### CI/CD Pipeline & Build System Improvements
Significant effort was put into streamlining the CI/CD process and migrating build configurations. This included restoring `compute-git-versions` as a native make target to fix CI errors [#19523](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19523), updating CircleCI to use `just` instead of `make` [#19482](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19482), and migrating the root Makefile to a `justfile` [#19477](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19477). Additionally, `cannon` testdata Makefiles were migrated to `justfiles` [#19483](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19483), and a fix was implemented for `just` installation in `cannon/Dockerfile.diff` [#19521](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19521).

### Rust-based Historical Proofs & Semgrep Configuration
Updates were made to port binary changes related to historical proofs in `rust/op-reth` [#19252](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19252). A bug fix was also applied to the CI to add `rust/op-reth/tests/` to `.semgrepignore` to prevent scan failures [#19522](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19522).

### Devstack and Contract Registry Updates
The `op-devstack` received an update to add explicit local contract artifact overrides [#19516](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19516). The `superchain-registry` submodule was also bumped to its latest main version, incorporating recent contract updates and prestates [#19528](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19528).

### Documentation for AI Agents
New documentation was added to provide guidance for AI agents on Go and Rust development workflows, covering tool versions, build/test/lint commands, and pre-commit/pre-PR checklists [#19518](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19518).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#19544](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19544) feat(kona): add lightweight follow node mode
- [#19543](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19543) fix(op-supernode): error on uninitialized chain sync status
- [#19542](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19542) fix(op-supernode): consolidate block-to-timestamp helpers and respect genesis offset
- [#19541](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19541) fix(op-interop-filter): handle zero start timestamp in lockstep validator
- [#19536](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19536) refactor: move OP EVM code into alloy-op-evm newtypes
- [#19535](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19535) ci-gate
- [#19534](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19534) chore: bump op-contracts release reference to v5.0.0-rc.2
- [#19533](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19533) refactor: move OP EVM code into alloy-op-evm newtypes
- [#19531](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19531) Dependabot/go modules/go modules 2468a94907
- [#19530](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19530) ci: migrate op-deployer Docker build from CircleCI to GitHub Actions#19329
- [#19527](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19527) chore: bump alloy-op-evm to latest revm
- [#19526](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19526) chore: replace stale make calls with just in CI, Dockerfile, and Go errors
- [#19525](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19525) chore: migrate rust/op-reth Makefiles to just
- [#19520](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19520) chore(rust): add just target for cargo-deny
- [#19519](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19519) op-acceptance-tests: simplify acceptance CI and remove flake-shake

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Derivation Pipeline Robustness
An audit of the derivation pipeline's external-input error handling was completed, ensuring that malformed or bad external L1 inputs do not halt derivation but are instead dropped, allowing processing to continue [#19491](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19491).

### Kona Batch Queue Behavior
An issue regarding span batch extraction failure in the BatchQueue returning `Critical` instead of flushing was closed. The decision was made to preserve historical behavior for invalid batch data, as it was previously unspecified and not encountered in production [#19511](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19511).

### op-supernode Sync Status Handling
A bug where `ChainContainer.SyncStatus()` returned an empty `eth.SyncStatus{}` when the virtual node was uninitialized, allowing silent consumption of invalid state, has been addressed and closed [#19538](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19538).

### Rust Docs Hosting
The issue concerning Rust documentation hosting was closed, as it is now captured within the broader documentation migration project [#1985](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/1985).

## NEW ISSUES

### CI/CD and Build System Issues
New issues highlight problems with the CI/CD pipeline, including the need to install `just` in GitHub Actions `docker-build-prep` due to the Make→Just migration [#19524](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19524).

### op-reth Sync and State Root Mismatch
Several critical issues were reported for `op-reth`, including sync stalls where `latest_block` becomes stuck despite active peers [#19529](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19529), and recurring state root mismatches on Base mainnet leading to permanent sync stalls and fatal crashes [#19532](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19532).

### op-supernode and op-interop-filter Logic Flaws
Issues were identified in `op-supernode` regarding the `BlockNumberToTimestamp` helper, which needs to respect `Genesis.L2.Number` [#19540](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19540) and consolidate duplicated helpers [#19539](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19539). Additionally, `op-interop-filter`'s `LockstepCrossValidator` can never advance when `startTimestamp` is 0 [#19537](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19537).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth Database Memory Leak
The issue [#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19212) regarding `op-reth` experiencing memory leaks due to long-open database read transactions continues to be active. A user reported seeing this issue on World Chain v1.10.1, causing multiple nodes to go down. The user inquired if the issue persists in v1.11.0, but the original reporter has not yet upgraded to that version. They noted that the behavior has not reoccurred in the last 7 days on v1.10.2.
